gist.headline: Small ideas, full worlds
gist.blurb: StoryForge has joined the writing garden. Bring an idea, pick a genre and Pollen budget, and leave with an illustrated little world of its own.
gist.summary: Added StoryForge to the writing app directory, letting users sign in through BYOP OAuth with PKCE, choose a Pollen budget and genre, and turn an idea into an illustrated AI micro-story.
gist.impact: People can now discover and launch StoryForge from Pollinations writing tools to make budget-controlled fantasy, sci-fi, mystery, and other illustrated short stories.
gist.visual_concept: Depict StoryForge as a cozy storybook-making nook: Polli helps a tiny illustrated book bloom from a seed-like idea prompt, with genre symbols such as a castle and small spaceship emerging from its pages. Include a retro terminal showing a simple OAuth key/lock motif, plus flowers and code-vines to connect the app directory addition to the Pollinations garden.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art storybook workshop where Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny writer’s beret, gently plants a glowing idea-seed into an open illustrated book; a tiny fantasy castle and pastel spaceship rise warmly from its pages beside a retro terminal with a small key icon. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, code-flowers and garden vines, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, emotionally warm and nostalgic.
